title: Durgamati - The Myth
desc: A government officer fights for justice but gets trapped in a conspiracy. As she tries to clear her name, a ghost takes control, leading to a thrilling and mysterious battle!

title: Powerstar James
desc: James, also known as Santhosh Kumar, manages at a security firm. He faces powerful, bad people in his job. Expect danger and intrigue as he navigates the situation.

title: Jigarwala Rakshak
desc: Ranjeet, a village man, is killed after speaking out against harsh ruler. His wife hides Amar's role, and revenge targets Amar's family.

title: Har Din Diwali
desc: Sai, a caring grandson, dedicates himself to making Raghu Ramayya's last days memorable when the elderly man's busy children fail to find time for him.

title: Aankhen
desc: Vijay, an ousted bank manager, trains three blind men for a heist to avenge injustice. Through conflict and sacrifice, Vijay is caught, and the men protect a kidnapped boy and hidden jewels.

title: Meg 2 - The Trench
desc: Jonas Taylor and a team of scientists encounter a massive prehistoric shark and other deadly creatures in the unexplored depths of the ocean.

title: Men In Black 2
desc: Agent K comes to know about a mysterious alien who is searching for the Light of Zartha on Earth. However, he would need help from his former partner who has retired and had his memories wiped.

title: Metro In Dino
desc: In Indian cities-Mumbai, Pune, Delhi, Kolkata-people's lives cross: Kajol and Monty argue; Chumki faces abuse; Parth arrives; Shruti, Aakash fear love; Shivani longs for Parimal.
